snippet.title: PIONER - Steam Next Fest Open Demo
snippet.description:
THE OPEN DEMO IS HERE! 
We’re super excited to let you know that the multiplayer PIONER demo will be open for testing during Steam Next Fest, from June 9–16!

Add it to your wishlist and get ready to jump in 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3105890/PIONER/

We’ll also be running closed beta tests with smaller groups later on. If you haven’t signed up yet, don’t miss out: https://pionergame.com/beta
